scope: Read-only independent method audit of IDEA000062 and IDEA000063 after source-quote repair. No execution approval or operative mutation.
overall: Both proposals preserve useful structural observations, but neither currently supports a semantic test. IDEA000062 has a circular scope/closure endpoint risk; IDEA000063 makes component continuity partly definitional. These are narrow design corrections, not empirical failures and not a requirement for confirmed translation.

assessments.finding: The named unit and contrast are concrete: hull-only positions versus edge participants. However, “alter scope or closure” and the falsifier “removing it leaves scope and closure unchanged” are not independently scoreable while hull membership and edge incidence are defined by the same admitted relation protocol. The source-observed aiin/chedy positions can support a topology audit, but do not by themselves show a semantic boundary role.
assessments.minimal_correction: Freeze an external boundary/closure annotation or an independent rendered consequence before scoring; then test whether the same position changes that endpoint while remaining outside incidence. Keep the omission-as-participant countermodel explicit.

source_pointer.quote:
The graph has 23 unique edge nodes and 25 edge incidences.  Only
`f80v.35#3` and `f86v6.25#4` are genuine shared nodes.  Two visually intervening
positions are not nodes:

- `f86v5.24#2 aiin` is an unbound quantity register inside the C010 hull;
- `f26r.2#5 chedy` is an exact state checkpoint inside the C011 hull.

The free `dy` at `f26r.2#7` is retained only to close the rendered clause; it
lies outside C011's #4--#6 hull.  These distinctions prevent readable prose
from silently becoming extra relation evidence.

assessments.finding: The proposal names connected components and predicts singleton/fan-out/serial signatures, but “internal participant continuity” is partly inherited from the edge graph used to define the components. The GDT701 counts (11 edges, 9 components, 23 nodes, 2 hull-only, 1 render-only) are structural outputs, not independently observed process boundaries.
assessments.minimal_correction: Predeclare an independent record-boundary or continuity endpoint, then compare graph components against paragraph/line units on held cases. A component that simply has connected edges cannot by that fact confirm a process microrecord.

preserved_limits: No broad record semantics, translation, participant identity, or new edge follows from GDT701.
Existing GDT701 zero-new-edge result is preserved as a structural result, not a semantic conclusion.
No claim that the structural candidates are impossible; only their current endpoints are insufficiently independent.
